_comment: Weapon with activated ability. activation_cost 3 at card level for {r}{r}{r}. per_turn 1 for 'Once per Turn'. INSTANT ability type for instant-speed activation. Target opposing hero via target spec (controller OPPONENT, zone HERO). DEAL_ARCANE with target OPPONENT deals to opposing hero. DRAW 1 for 'draw a card for each arcane damage dealt this way' - fixed 1 damage means draw 1. Release notes confirm this cannot attack and is not an action card.
